rapa_nui_food_limits.interpretation: The independent held-out limit remains a real physical contradiction. The new crop evidence and explicit uncertainty prior do not resolve the overestimate; no anchor-specific multiplier or training target is permitted. The next model change must address globally shared soil-nutrient, rock-garden/fallow, and sustainable-yield physics and must be tested against England, Iceland, and all grouped anchors.
